notes.title: News about the new game - My Personal Angel
notes.notes:
In a few weeks will be on sale a new visual novel from morojenoe's empire -  [b]My Personal Angel[/b]. With good or bad story - depends on your choice in this game.

If you're interested, you can find page with this game here:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/664570/

Thanks for attention.
